action.objective: Win material with Bxe6, exchanging the bishop for the e6 bishop and keeping the strong center.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested c4e6 (Bxe6) and a dedicated depth-4 verification confirmed it as exact 208, commit_ready, with no forced mate against White and only checking reply b6b2 covered with not_found tactical refutation. Bxe6 wins a bishop: after fxe6, Bxd6 regains material and White keeps Qd4 pressure and the large center. This is the single commit_ready move; no risk acceptance needed.
